originality.rationale: The nearest published claims are the exact same-generator scale ray (z=0) and a two-directional family with fourth coordinate identically zero. Their proofs and stated formulae do not imply the transverse h=(1,-1,-1,z) perturbation boundary; the original source has only the (t,z)=(1,0) counterexample. Determinant and equivalence searches were performed, and available complete texts were inspected. Residual historical risk is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: The complete Fradelizi et al. manuscript was not retrieved; abstract-level noncoverage does not exclude an unindexed explicit calculation in an appendix.
Other affine-coordinate reparametrizations of this eight-generator configuration may appear in less searchable published notes.
Originality is a bounded best-knowledge assessment, not an independent global certification.

value.rationale: A sharp two-parameter perturbation criterion resolves when a natural discrete 4D non-Rayleigh zonotope witness survives fourth-coordinate tilt and segment dilation. The complete open instability tongue, its unique scale ceiling 2, its limiting transverse directions −1 and 1/3, and its asymmetric unit-scale tolerances are motivated quantitative geometric boundaries rather than arbitrary stand-alone examples; these exact conditions can inform robustness analysis of nearby zonotope volume inequalities.
